title_zh: 了解冥想课形式并选定靠门座位

scenario.label_zh: 了解冥想课形式并选定靠门座位
scenario.goal_zh: 说明静坐时的紧张表现，确认课程允许换姿势或离席，并选择靠门开始体验

context_zh: 虚构休闲课程场景。首次参加者在冥想体验课开始前询问教师，不涉及诊断或疗效承诺。
author: author-phase11-b

sentences.speaker: Dina
sentences.text: This is my first meditation class. Do we have to sit completely still for the whole hour?

sentences.speaker: Rowan
sentences.text: No. There are short seated periods with breaks, and you can change position or step outside.

sentences.speaker: Dina
sentences.text: My nerves tend to manifest as a need to keep moving. I don't want to distract everyone.

sentences.speaker: Rowan
sentences.text: You're welcome to sit near the door. You don't have to explain if you need a break.

sentences.speaker: Dina
sentences.text: I'll start there, then. Knowing I can step out makes it easier to give the class a try.

sentences.speaker: Rowan
sentences.text: That seat is free. Take your time getting settled.
